in_latin.name: Franziska
in_latin.meaning: Derived from Germanic name, Franziska means 'free woman'
in_latin.long_meaning: Franziska is a compound name derived from the Germanic words 'franz,' meaning 'free man,' and 'iska,' meaning 'woman.' It is believed to have originated in the Middle Ages as a feminine form of the masculine name Franz. In the Christian tradition, Franziska signifies independence, self-reliance, and empowerment. As a given name, it conveys confidence, courage, and a strong sense of identity.
